items.title: DISCERN: Preserve at Write, Resolve at Read for Persistent LLM-Agent Memory
items.title_zh: DISCERN：写入时保留、读取时消解的持久化 LLM 智能体记忆
items.summary: DISCERN is an agent-memory framework that keeps a strictly additive bi-temporal provenance graph at write time and resolves entities, time-states and abstention through an agentic read loop with a zero-LLM tool surface. On the 310-query ENT-310 benchmark it reaches abstention F1 0.924 versus at most 0.802 for eight baselines and macro answer correctness 0.861 versus 0.806, with entity resolution at 0.800 where no baseline exceeds 0.40.

items.title: Alibaba opens Qwen4-Max preview with a million-token context window
items.title_zh: 阿里巴巴开放 Qwen4-Max 预览，支持百万 token 上下文
items.summary: Alibaba opened a preview of Qwen4-Max, the flagship of its next-generation Qwen family, with image and video inputs and up to a million tokens of context. Developers can access it through the Token Plan subscription and the Qwen app.

items.title: ShadowBench: Exposing Lexical Anchoring and the Illusion of Forgetting in Large Language Models
items.title_zh: ShadowBench：揭示大语言模型的词汇锚定与“遗忘幻觉”
items.summary: ShadowBench evaluates latent entity association with a dual-trait association task that removes explicit entity names, and finds a "Shadow Gap" of over 20% performance loss across model scales up to GPT-5.4 and Claude-Sonnet-4.6. Applied to machine unlearning, its Latent Entity Leakage Rate shows that popular "forgotten" entities are reconstructed in internal reasoning traces in over 74% of cases, indicating superficial rather than parametric erasure.

items.title: ADAPT: Agentic Diff-Aware Patch Testing for Pull Requests
items.title_zh: ADAPT：面向拉取请求的智能体差异感知补丁测试
items.summary: ADAPT uses an autonomous coding agent to analyze a pull request's diff, generate change-focused unit tests, and refine them with a fail-to-pass verification tool that reports uncovered changed lines. On 426 real-world PRs it reaches an F2P rate of 62.0% with GPT-4o and 89.9% with GPT-5-mini, versus 35.4% reported for BLAST, and full patch coverage on 83.9% of 137 shared PRs versus 79.6% for ChaCo.

items.title: Food Critic: An Agentic Visualization System for Auditable Restaurant-Safety Reasoning
items.title_zh: Food Critic：面向可审计餐厅安全推理的智能体可视化系统
items.summary: Food Critic is an agentic visualization system that combines public health inspection records with crowd review data and compares database-only ReAct, retrieval-augmented and ontology-guided grounding. It externalizes the agent's reasoning as inspectable visual evidence to study provenance and human-agent collaboration in grounded decision support.

items.title: Improved Elastic Weight Consolidation as an Optimization Constraint for Continual Learning
items.title_zh: 改进的弹性权重巩固：作为持续学习的优化约束
items.summary: The paper derives Elastic Weight Consolidation as a first-order form of a constraint that preserves chosen functionals of old behavior, and shows that EWC's empirical-Fisher weighting under-penalizes samples the model already fits well. Improved EWC penalizes movement off each old output's loss level set instead, raising ImageNet-R accuracy over EWC by 2.00 points (95% CI 0.93-3.07) in a held-out evaluation across classification, segmentation, language, forecasting and diffusion.

items.title: Show Your Work in Swahili: Reinforcement Learning for Native-Language Mathematical Reasoning
items.title_zh: 用斯瓦希里语展示推理过程：面向母语数学推理的强化学习
items.summary: Fikiria is a two-stage SFT plus GRPO recipe for Swahili mathematical reasoning whose reward combines answer accuracy with ChrF++ similarity to an in-language reference chain of thought. Fikiria-AfriqueQwen-14B reaches 79.2% on AfriMGSM Swahili under a fixed prompt and strict answer-format scoring, while the authors note that GPT-4o outputs were preferred in a small human evaluation.

items.title: The Noise Floor of a Quantization Comparison: Engine, restart, batch and kernel drift, measured against 8-bit and 4-bit effects in two decision models
items.title_zh: 量化比较的噪声底线：引擎、重启、批处理与内核漂移相对 8 位和 4 位效应的测量
items.summary: The study measures non-quantization sources of decision drift for two Cloudflare decision models on an NVIDIA GB10 and states quantization effects as excess over them. Non-quantization sources move 0-0.92% of decisions while 4-bit quantization moves 3.50-5.79%, and a Q4_K_M build changes net accuracy by only six questions out of 31,275 even as 436 decisions get worse.

items.title: Curiosity-0826-4B: Generative Medical Event Sequence Modeling Across Pediatric and Adult Populations
items.title_zh: Curiosity-0826-4B：跨儿科与成人人群的生成式医疗事件序列建模
items.summary: Curiosity-0826-4B is a 4.3B-parameter generative medical event foundation model trained on Epic Cosmos that simulates patient timelines for zero-shot clinical prediction, with a 16K context window. It matches or exceeds the prior 1B Curiosity-0226 model on shared tasks, cutting laboratory-value MAE by 18-46%, and adds pediatric and mortality prediction results while requiring further validation.
